Introduction

Hello!
Welcome to "Items" page. You'll find here basic informations about each:

  • Scrap item
  • Loggable item
  • Videotape item
  • Ingredient item

Basic information like: item name, item preview image, conductivity, weight, maximum, minimum and average value, is item two-handed, locations where it can spawn and percentage spawn chances.
Some of these item types have their own unique icon that appears in your inventory when you pick them.
